sources.research_use: Recombinant protein solubility and expression under measured chaperone contexts
sources.constraint: A single observation per protein does not support fitting a dedicated predictor.

sources.research_use: Protein production projects with measured expression and solubility outcomes
sources.constraint: Verify original project metadata, data reuse terms and overlap with fixed SWI training data.

sources.research_use: Stability measurements for previously designed small proteins
sources.constraint: Within-protein prediction and transfer to an unseen parent protein require different evaluations.

sources.research_use: Protein stability measurements with mutation and assay metadata
sources.constraint: Deduplicate original experiments shared with ProTherm, ProtaBank or other source papers; keep thermodynamic endpoints distinct.

sources.research_use: Researcher-contributed protein engineering studies and assay tables
sources.constraint: Review individual study scope, accessibility, permissions, measurement definitions and source overlap before import.

sources.research_use: Published biochemical reaction kinetics with substrate and experimental context
sources.constraint: Separate Km, kcat and derived efficiencies; normalize units and retain substrate, temperature and pH metadata.

sources.research_use: Researcher-supplied industrial-enzyme and protein-production project data
sources.constraint: Bind original measurements, reuse permission and a concrete intended prediction; register only after independent validation.

sources.research_use: Measured protein-specific thermal response in Arabidopsis
sources.constraint: The admitted tasks share a study cohort; preserve independent sample groups, source reference normalization and predeclared final partitions.

sources.research_use: Measured protein abundance in food and fermentation yeast populations
sources.constraint: The admitted tasks share a population cohort and pooled QC; distinguish retrospective QC-relative measurements from prospective biological validation.

sources.research_use: Protein-specific abundance prediction from measured amino-acid concentrations in laboratory S288c-derived yeast deletion strains
sources.constraint: 2292 source-bound protein tasks admitted with all 19 measured covariates and common deleted-genotype partitions (600/200/200 per task). Cross-study genotype matching is not same-sample pairing. Preparation created no trained or published models; feature variants do not add scientific scopes.

domain_baselines.scope: Partial author-method reproduction with 19 measured covariates, author core package versions and a frozen 50-iteration five-fold reference-protein search. Four-task final prediction comparison independently replayed; two Scientist scopes published, one completed two generations, neither final generated model beat its strongest fixed control.
